title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Earned-Premium Method for Loan-Event Cancellations
content:
**Earned-premium method for a loan event (Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs, loan-event schedule).** When the certificate has been in force fewer than 90 days, counted from its start date to today, Tidemark treats as earned the greater of one quarter (0.25) of the premium and the premium multiplied by the days in force divided by the days in the term, and the loan-event credit is the premium less that earned amount; when it has been in force 90 to 180 days, the earned amount is the premium multiplied by the whole months in force plus one more month for the month in progress, divided by 12, and the credit is the premium less that earned amount; when it has been in force more than 180 days, the credit is the premium multiplied by the days from today to its expiration date, divided by the days from its start date to its expiration date.

The premium, start date and expiration date are those of the certificate's term in force. For a loan event, months in force are whole calendar months from the start date to today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached, and days between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the later date, the earlier date excluded and the later date included.

| Days in force, start date to today | Earned amount | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Fewer than 90 | The greater of one quarter of the premium and the premium times days in force over days in the term | Premium less earned amount |
| 90 to 180 | Premium times (whole months in force plus one) over 12 | Premium less earned amount |
| More than 180 | — | Premium times days from today to expiration over days in the term |

## Hypothetical illustrations (premium 1,200.00 dollars, 365-day term)

- 40 days in force: pro rata earned 131.51 dollars; one quarter is 300.00 dollars, the greater; credit 900.00 dollars.
- 120 days in force, 3 whole months: earned 1,200.00 times 4 over 12, that is 400.00 dollars; credit 800.00 dollars.
- 200 days in force, 165 days to expiration: credit 1,200.00 times 165 over 365, that is 542.47 dollars.
